priority: ADR-023 — we prioritise HIGH CERTAINTY over HIGH DETECTION: specificity at the op-point is the criterion, recall is a constraint to satisfy, and MAE ranks nothing. A low recall here is usually the choice working. Read spec first, and read recall beside the positive rate.
